claims.sourceText: National Archives, Information Security Oversight Office
claims.text: ISOO publishes an Annual Report to the President with statistics and analysis on Classified National Security Information and Controlled Unclassified Information; the FY2024 report is published.

claims.sourceText: National Archives, Information Security Oversight Office
claims.text: ISOO is 'responsible to the President for policy and oversight of the Government-wide security classification system and the National Industrial Security Program', with authority from Executive Order 13526 and Executive Order 13556.

edges.label: the office charged with counting the classification system, and therefore the boundary of the public map
edges.note: ISOO is housed at the National Archives and is responsible to the President for policy and oversight of the government-wide security classification system and the National Industrial Security Program, under Executive Orders 13526 and 13556. Where ISOO's annual reporting stops is where this domain's open-source organisational mapping has to switch to inference.

b.label: Waived unacknowledged special access program (waived USAP)

edges.label: NISP oversight is the only government-wide window on contractor-held classified work
edges.note: ISOO is 'responsible to the President for policy and oversight of the Government-wide security classification system and the National Industrial Security Program'. A contractor-held program with no government sponsor of record would be visible, if anywhere, through NISP - and ISOO has never been directed at the UAP question.

edges.note: NARA hosts both the statutory UAP collection and the Information Security Oversight Office, the body responsible to the President for the classification system.
